The '''Malastarian Art Union''' was an organization dedicated to art, operating on [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] as of [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. The Art Union posted a bounty for [[Guanolta]], a member of [[Sebolto's drug cartel]]. They wanted him both for mixing several sets of rare paint in a public art display and the sale of death sticks to the young of [[Pixelito/Legends|Pixelito]]. [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] claimed the bounty alive for them.
